Bring your files home

Move from Google Drive in three steps.

Uncloud brings Drive home through the folder the Google Drive app keeps on your computer. Nothing is deleted from Google.

  1. 1

    Mirror Drive to the host

    On the computer that runs Uncloud, install Google Drive for desktop and set it to mirror your files, so they’re stored on the drive.

  2. 2

    Add the Drive folder

    In Uncloud, click Add files, choose This computer, and pick the Google Drive folder. Add all of it or just what you need.

  3. 3

    Your copy is yours

    Files are copied into your own space and the originals stay put. Adding the folder again later only brings what’s new.

Questions

Switching from Google Drive

How do I move my files from Google Drive to Uncloud?

+

Install Google Drive for desktop on the computer that runs Uncloud and set it to mirror your files. Then click Add files, choose This computer, and add the Google Drive folder. Files are copied, never moved.

Does Uncloud replace Gmail or Google Photos?

+

No. Uncloud holds your files. Gmail, Google Photos and the other benefits of a Google One plan are separate, so keep the plan you need for those.

Who can see my files?

+

Only you. Your files live on a computer in your home, not with a cloud company. Each person sees only their own space, and files travel encrypted between your devices and the host.

How much storage do I get?

+

As much as your computer and connected drives can hold. Plug in a bigger drive and you have more room. There are no storage tiers and no per-person charges.

What does Uncloud cost?

+

Uncloud Home is $99 once. Join early access to lock in $79 at launch, with a 30-day free trial and no credit card. Unlimited household members and devices, remote access, migrations and software updates are included.
